prompt: Six independently generated left-facing seven-pose strips. Their complete prompts and source hashes are in tools/generate-art/e-indigo-locomotion-left-strips.json.

review.source: All six source strips were visually reviewed and assembled; the exact42 atlas and five packed left-facing atlases were visually reviewed. The set preserves E. Indigo canon: azure skin, icy hair, small blue antlers, anatomical left-black/right-white sclera with cyan irises, lower-face ring, gold outline heart, ripped gray jeans and bare feet. No mirroring is used.

assembly.operation: Each strip's seven existing alpha components were isolated by nearest-component ownership after transparent16px outer padding. Crops were uniformly scaled to a common maximum height174px and placed on a transparent192x192 grid at a shared baseline184. No poses were drawn, duplicated or mirrored.

sourceStrips.prompt: Draw an original production sprite strip for JAMVERSE '96. Seven separate complete full-body drawings of E. Indigo in ONE horizontal row, arranged 7 columns by1 row, read left-to-right. Do not create extra rows. Each figure is independently articulated, with obvious transparent gaps between neighbors and at least 8% transparent margin at both top and bottom. Figure height should stay below about 78% of the canvas height; keep antlers, flowing hair and bare feet comfortably away from all image borders. Character must face SCREEN-LEFT with body and stride, three-quarter view; never mirror a reference. Use reference image1 as precise face canon, reference image2 only for body scale, outfit, palette and sprite style. Adult male supernatural athlete with azure blue skin, messy icy-white hair, TWO small blue deer antlers, anatomical LEFT sclera black and RIGHT sclera white, both eyes with cyan irises and clearly open; no visor or eye band. Single smoky tilted black orbital ring around mouth/chin BELOW both eyes, exactly like the face reference, never across eyes. Bare upper chest with a clear golden hollow outline heart. Ripped gray jeans, bare feet, no shoes, no armor. Preserve anatomical eye sides even though body faces screen-left; draw the eye geometry anatomically, not by flipping. Empty hands; physics ball added by game. Crisp readable original late-1990s arcade art with bold dark ink lines, consistent face/body/outfit, complete figure. Transparent RGBA only: no checkerboard, no floor, court, shadows, glow, text, labels, numbers, panels, cell lines, logos, ball, or extra props. Exactly seven separate poses in one row. Strip1 poses, seven different moments read left to right: idle frame1 neutral relaxed stance; idle2 gentle inhale, shoulders slightly raised; idle3 weight shifts onto left foot; idle4 subtle weight shift onto right foot; idle5 one heel lifts and settles; idle6 relaxed arm and torso variation; idle-with-ball frame1, a slightly lower ready stance with empty hands cupped to receive a separate game ball. All upright, distinct, naturally continuous.
